title: UI/UX Developer
description:
We are looking for a creative and user focused UX/UI Developer to design and develop intuitive, engaging, and responsive digital experiences for AIVIDA’s websites, applications, and digital platforms. The ideal candidate will combine strong design skills with front end development knowledge to create seamless user experiences that support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design user friendly interfaces and engaging digital experiences for websites, web applications and mobile platforms.
* Conduct user research, analyze user behavior and translate insights into effective design solutions.
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, mockups, and high\-fidelity visual designs.
* Develop responsive and interactive interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and relevant front\-end frameworks.
* Ensure designs are optimized for usability, accessibility, performance and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Collaborate with product managers, developers, designers and business teams to define and implement product requirements.
* Maintain and improve design systems, style guides, reusable components and UI standards.
* Test interfaces with users, gather feedback and continuously improve the overall user experience.
* Review implemented designs and work closely with developers to ensure visual and functional accuracy.
* Stay updated on UX/UI trends, design tools, emerging technologies and industry best practices.
* Ensure consistent brand communication across all digital products and platforms.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Design, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in UX/UI design and front end development.
* Strong proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch or similar platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
* Knowledge of front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue.js will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of user\-centered design, usability principles, accessibility standards, and design systems.
* Strong visual, analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Experience designing healthcare, wellness or service\-based digital products will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at \[Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/), and through our businesses including \[Trane®](http://www.trane.com/index.html) and \[Thermo King](http://www.thermoking.com/na/en.html), sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? Learn about our \[benefits](http://careers.tranetechnologies.com/global/en/benefits) designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.



We boldly go.


**Where is the work:**



Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.



At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.


### **Job Summary**



The User Experience (UX) Designer champions the user perspective across all stages of the digital product lifecycle. This role leads and supports user research, facilitates design thinking activities, and creates intuitive, user‑centered digital experiences. Working in an agile environment, the UX Designer translates business objectives, user needs, and technical requirements into high‑quality designs that elevate customer and partner experiences and drive consistency across the organization.


### **Responsibilities**


* Design user experiences for new and existing digital applications.
* Collaborate with product owners, developers, testers, stakeholders, and other UX team members in an agile environment.
* Communicate design decisions, rationale, and best practices to stakeholders at all levels.
* Contribute to design principles, guidelines, and pattern libraries.
* Support and help govern a unified enterprise design system.
* Stay informed on UX trends, research methods, and user preferences.
* Partner with the UX Research team to interpret analytics, conduct usability testing, and support user research.
* Work independently with strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.
* Advocate for design thinking, user‑centered design, and user research within the organization.
* Produce UX deliverables including personas, journey maps, sitemaps, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and style guides.

### **Qualifications**


* 5\-7 years of experience in user experience or interactive design for web and mobile applications within an agile environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human‑Computer Interaction, or related field.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Proficiency with tools such as Figma, Axure, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar platforms.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating user experience design expertise.
* Ability to work effectively with research partners, design agencies, and implementation vendors.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality work.


Key Competencies:


* Strong user‑centered design and design thinking capabilities.
* Ability to facilitate design studios, workshops, and research activities.
* Ability to balance business needs, user goals, and technical constraints.
* Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration skills.
* High attention to detail with the ability to produce clear, actionable design artifacts.
* Adaptability, initiative, and ability to work independently.
* (Preferred) Experience in HVAC or manufacturing, responsive mobile design, Salesforce or Adobe Experience Manager, B2B and B2C experience design, visual design, industrial design, or content writing.

title: UX Designer
description:
**Role Overview**


As a UX Designer at NETGEAR, you will craft intuitive, engaging interfaces for our enterprise and consumer networking products. You’ll partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Visual Design teams to translate complex networking concepts into clear, user\-centered experiences across web, mobile, and desktop platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **User Research:** Plan and conduct usability studies, interviews, and surveys to uncover user needs and pain points.
* **Interaction Design:** Develop wireframes, user flows, and prototypes that illustrate product functionality and user journeys.
* **Visual \& Information Design:** Create high\-fidelity mockups and design specs aligned with NETGEAR’s brand and design system.
* **AI\-Assisted Design \& Prototyping:** Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Figma Make, and other AI\-powered UX tools to accelerate ideation, research synthesis, UX writing, design exploration, and rapid prototyping.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively across devices.
* **Iteration \& Validation:** Gather feedback from stakeholders and end users; iterate designs to optimize usability and performance.
* **Documentation:** Maintain and evolve our UX guidelines, component libraries, and style documentation.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years of complete UX Design experience, preferably on B2B, SaaS, enterprise, or networking products.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree preferably in UX/UI Design, Human–Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, or related field.
* **Tools \& Skills:**


	+ Strong proficiency with Figma (components, auto\-layout, prototyping).
	+ Experience with Figma Make and AI\-assisted prototyping workflows.
	+ Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, and other emerging AI tools for UX research, ideation, UX writing, and rapid prototyping.
	+ Familiarity with usability testing tools (e.g., UserTesting, Maze).
	+ Solid foundation in graphic design (typography, color, layout).
	+ Experience with web \& mobile app design strategies.
	+ Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles.
	+ Experience with AI tools for UX and product design.
* **Attributes:**


	+ Strong empathy and communication skills, able to articulate design choices.
	+ Analytical mindset with a focus on data\-driven design decisions.
	+ Ability to learn networking concepts quickly and translate them into user workflows.
	+ Collaborative spirit and comfort working in Agile/Scrum environments.
	+ A portfolio showcasing design process and outcomes.

**Company Statement/Values:**


At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.


We're a performance\-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world\-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the *Next Gear* by living our values: we **Dare to Transform** the future, **Connect and Delight** our customers, **Communicate Courageously** with each other and collaborate to **Win It Together**. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.


We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward\-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.

*NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.*

title: Graphic Designer
company: Meritus AI Learning Experiences Private Limited
description:

We are looking for a creative Graphic Designer with 1–2 years of experience to join our design team. The ideal candidate has a strong visual sense, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ideas into compelling designs across digital and print media.

Responsibilities

* Create visual assets for branding, marketing, social media, web, packaging, and print.
* Develop creative concepts while maintaining brand consistency.
* Collaborate with design, marketing, content, and product teams.
* Manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines effectively.
* Prepare production\-ready artwork for digital and print applications.
* Leverage AI\-powered creative tools to support ideation, visual development, and design workflows.

Requirements

* 1–2 years of professional graphic design experience.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience across both digital and print design.
* Strong creative thinking, attention to detail, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong portfolio is mandatory.

Preferred / Bonus Skills

* Experience with AI\-powered creative tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, ChatGPT, or similar.
* Familiarity with 3D software such as Blender or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of CAD design, 3D modelling, and product models.
* Familiarity with Figma, Canva, or CorelDRAW.
* Basic knowledge of motion graphics, video editing, or UI/UX.

Work Location: In person
